title: Distinguish IDs with Newtypes
goal: Use dedicated tuple structs to make mixing up raw ID integers a compile error.

source.attribution: adapted from API Guidelines: Type Safety

hints: Notice how `user` and `group` are created in `main`. They are wrapper structs, not raw `u64` values.
The function parameter types must match the wrapper struct types defined at the top.
explanation: The newtype pattern wraps primitive types in single-field tuple structs like `UserId(pub u64)`. Raw integers or `type` aliases permit swapping arguments accidentally because `type` aliases do not create distinct types. Using `UserId` and `GroupId` in signatures enforces exact domain boundary checking at compile time. Passing `u64` or swapped newtypes triggers type mismatch error `E0308`.
